title: Verify that the Newsletter Management create/edit form renders all required fields in English

steps.action: Log in to Liferay CMS as Administrator

steps.expected: Create form displays fields: Title (EN/AR), Subject Line (EN/AR), Short Description (EN/AR), Content (EN/AR rich text), Banner Image upload, Attachments upload, Language dropdown, Status dropdown, Publish Date, Expiry Date

title: Verify that the Newsletter Listing page displays Title, Status, Publish Date, Created By, Last Modified, and Actions columns

steps.expected: Columns Title, Status, Publish Date, Created By, Last Modified, Actions (View/Edit/Delete/Publish/Archive) are all present and populated for each row

title: Verify that the section enable/disable toggles are visible before sending a newsletter

steps.expected: Toggle controls visible for Latest News, Upcoming Events, Circulars & Announcements, Publications & Research, each defaulting to Enabled

title: Verify that an admin can archive a Published newsletter

steps.expected: Status changes to Archived; success toast shown (EN+AR); newsletter no longer eligible for Publish/Schedule actions

title: Verify that leaving Short Description (EN) empty is accepted since the field is optional

steps.action: Leave Short Description (EN) empty; fill all other mandatory fields

steps.expected: Draft saved successfully with no validation error for Short Description (EN)

title: Verify that leaving Short Description (AR) empty is accepted since the field is optional

steps.action: Leave Short Description (AR) empty; fill all other mandatory fields

steps.expected: Draft saved successfully with no validation error for Short Description (AR)

title: Verify that Banner Image accepts a valid JPG under 2 MB

steps.action: Upload banner.jpg (1.2 MB) to Banner Image

steps.expected: Draft saved successfully with the banner image attached

title: Verify that leaving Banner Image empty is accepted since the field is optional

steps.action: Leave Banner Image empty; fill all other mandatory fields

steps.expected: Draft saved successfully with no validation error for Banner Image

title: Verify that Banner Image rejects a file exceeding 2 MB or an unsupported format

steps.action: Attempt to upload banner.gif (3.5 MB, GIF format) to Banner Image

steps.expected: Validation error shown indicating unsupported format and/or file exceeds 2 MB; file not attached; draft not saved with this file

title: Verify that Attachments accepts a valid PDF file

steps.expected: Draft saved successfully with the attachment stored

title: Verify that leaving Attachments empty is accepted since the field is optional

steps.action: Leave Attachments empty; fill all other mandatory fields

steps.expected: Draft saved successfully with no validation error for Attachments

title: Verify that Attachments rejects an unsupported file format

steps.action: Attempt to upload image.png to Attachments

steps.expected: Validation error shown indicating only PDF, DOC, DOCX are supported; file not attached

title: Verify that saving a newsletter with no Language selected is rejected

steps.action: Leave the Language dropdown at its unselected/placeholder state; fill remaining mandatory fields

steps.expected: Validation error "Language is required." displayed; draft not saved

title: Verify that saving a newsletter with no Status selected is rejected

steps.action: Leave the Status dropdown unselected; fill remaining mandatory fields

steps.expected: Validation error "Status is required." displayed; save blocked

title: Verify that Publish Date accepts a valid future date/time

steps.action: Enter tomorrow's date at 09:00 in Publish Date

steps.expected: Draft saved successfully with Publish Date stored

title: Verify that Expiry Date accepts a valid date after the Publish Date

steps.expected: Draft saved successfully with both dates stored

title: Verify that an Expiry Date on or before the Publish Date is rejected

steps.action: Set Expiry Date = Oct 10 2026 09:00 (same as Publish Date)

steps.expected: Validation error indicating Expiry Date must be after Publish Date displayed; draft not saved

title: Verify that enabling then disabling the Upcoming Events section toggle correctly updates the Send/Schedule preview

steps.action: On the Send/Schedule step, disable the Upcoming Events toggle
steps.expected: Toggle switches to Disabled; preview no longer shows the Upcoming Events section
Toggle switches back to Enabled; preview shows the Upcoming Events section again

title: Verify that an Administrator is not denied any Newsletter Management permission (negative-control sanity check)

steps.action: Attempt every RBAC-gated action: Approve, Reject, Publish, Schedule, Archive, manage subscribers
steps.expected: Every action completes successfully; no Access Denied message is ever shown

title: Verify that publishing a newsletter whose enabled sections have zero currently-published items sends without those empty sections

steps.action: Confirm Latest News, Upcoming Events, Circulars & Announcements, and Publications & Research each have zero published items
Publish a newsletter with all sections enabled
steps.expected: Newsletter publishes successfully; sent email shows a graceful empty-state rather than an error or broken layout

title: Verify that only Active/Urgent published Circulars & Announcements are included in the Newsletter Issue Email

steps.action: Confirm one Circular is published with Active/Urgent flag and one is published without it
Enable Circulars & Announcements section and publish the newsletter

steps.expected: Email's Circulars & Announcements section lists only the Active/Urgent published circular
